paragraphs: The F-Pace P400 sits at the performance end of the Jaguar SUV range, offering a powerful and responsive driving experience. It uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid technology, delivering 400PS. Fitted across the X761 generation from launch in 2016 to the present day, the AJ300P is part of Jaguar's modern Ingenium engine family and shares its fundamental architecture with the diesel variants in the range. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P engines for every F-Pace P400 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace P400 from 2023 to present. The AJ300P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P rebuild.
